name: Potion of Diminution

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: The Reduce part of Enlarge/Reduce for 1d4 hours (no Concentration).
text: For 1d4 hours after drinking, you are under the reduce half of the Enlarge/Reduce spell without needing Concentration: you drop one size category, make Strength checks and Strength saving throws with Disadvantage, and deal 1d4 less damage with your weapons. A speck of red in the liquid constantly dwindles to a pinpoint and swells again.
